topic: The cricketer who faked his death to escape a match-fixing scandal
hook: He faked his own death to escape cricket's biggest scandal.
script: He faked his own death to escape cricket's biggest scandal. Danish Kaneria was banned for life for match fixing. A man connected to the scandal allegedly staged his own disappearance to avoid prosecution. Investigations spread across continents. Cricket's dark underworld exposed. Nothing was ever the same. Follow for cricket stories darker than fiction.
